checks.comparison: admissible requires BatchIterations.SmoothLower <d, L, sigma^2, eps, Delta, x0, 0> I; checked the provider: fields hasGradient (HasGradientAt I.f (gradient I.f x) x for all x, i.e. differentiability) and lipschitz (||grad f x - grad f y|| <= p.L ||x - y||) with p.L = Params.L (second field of BatchIterations.Params); valid gives L > 0. Exactly Assumption 1.

SmoothLower.gap: I.f p.x0 - I.lower = p.Delta with x0 the fifth/sixth fields mapped to Params.Delta and Params.x0 (field order d, L, v, eps, Delta, x0, extra checked). Delta is thus exactly f(x^0) - f^inf (L217).
SmoothLower.lower: I.lower <= I.f x for all x, I.lower being the instance's f^inf (Rennala.Instance = {f, lower}). Matches L216.

IID (fun k xi => xi k) mu P: coordinates measurable, iIndepFun under P, marginal mu; the oracle (arrivalOracle ... P g) uses coordinate k at call k. This is the accepted i.i.d.-stream reading of L151.
IsStochasticGradient (Point d) Omega mu I.f g sigma: unbiased (integral g x dmu = gradient f x for all x), with joint measurability of g and integrability of g x. Matches L225.

IsStochasticGradient.variance: integral ||g x - gradient f x||^2 dmu <= sigma^2 (sigma passed, squared in the field), with variance integrability; valid has 0 <= sigma. Matches L222/L226 including sigma = 0.

admissible: exists arrive : N -> Fin n with O = arrivalOracle (publicInput p) arrive P g. Convergence quantifies over every admissible oracle, hence over every deterministic arrival order independent of the samples (MODA).
No extra smoothness condition; the v/eps/extra fields of BatchIterations.Params are not used by SmoothLower.
Delta is a parameter forced to equal the instance gap; nothing extra.
Justified by L216.
No restriction beyond the accepted interpretation; P is an abstract law, not prescribed as a product measure.
Measurability/integrability are the standard conditions making the expectation defined (repository AGENTS.md convention).
Justified by L226.
Justified by L890; the arrival time 0 is irrelevant to T41.
Params d n R K : N, L sigma eps Delta : R, x0 : Point d. valid: 0 < L, 0 <= sigma, 0 < eps, 1 <= R. Matches the accepted domains.

publicInput passes d, n, stepSize L sigma eps R, R, x0, K to the algorithm; SmoothLower and IsStochasticGradient use the same L, sigma, x0, Delta and instance f; arrivalOracle receives publicInput p, arrive, P, g. Consistent identities.

valid is a conjunction of definedness conditions and the horizon; admissible a conjunction with existential sample space/law/oracle/order; successful = Measurable output /\ EpsStationary. Polarity correct.
Hypotheses exactly A1, A2, A3 (with independence) and MODA plus T41/pos and T41/horizon; no strengthening.

stepSize = 1/(2RL) if sigma = 0 else min(1/(2RL), eps/(4 L sigma^2)) (accepted sigma = 0 convention, consistent with min{.,+infinity}); horizon 8RL Delta/eps + 16 sigma^2 L Delta/eps^2 <= K with R, K cast to reals. Exact.
allowedAlgorithm q A := A = ringmaster q pins Algorithm 5.
Successful is evaluated under the template product law (uniform seed x P); EpsStationary uses that measure. mu is a ProbabilityMeasure (IsProbabilityMeasure instance for IsStochasticGradient).
successful: Measurable output and EpsStationary I.f (output.1) P eps, i.e. E||grad f(x^J)||^2 <= eps for the uniformly selected iterate; equals the source average.
Instance = Rennala.Instance d (f and f^inf, hidden); Output = Point d x R; oracle hidden behind the existential; arrival order hidden. Public/hidden split as planned.
Provider definitions inspected (SmoothLower fields, IsStochasticGradient fields, IID fields) and match their uses above.
spec uses alg's accepted declarations (Public, Query, Reply, arrivalOracle, ringmaster, EpsStationary) with matching arguments.
sigma = 0 branch; K = 0 allowed iff Delta = 0 by the horizon; n = 0 makes admissible unsatisfiable (no arrive : N -> Fin 0), vacuous but outside the source's scope.
